# ACLED Sudan: weekly build vs country-month-year file (generated by scripts/acled_crosscheck.py)

Weekly file `Africa_aggregated_data_up_to_week_of-2026-10-17.xlsx` (SHA-256 `d3c200e347a7…`); country-month-year file `number_of_political_violence_events_by_country-month-year_as-of-23Oct2026.xlsx` (SHA-256 `a8459f0681c8…`). Both gitignored; monthly values stay in `logs/v2/acled/` and are not committed.

Country = exactly "Sudan". Period 2014-10 → 2022-12: 432 weeks, 87 of them span two months. Political violence (primary, ACLED's own definition, author decision 2026-10-31) = DISORDER_TYPE contains "Political violence"; sensitivity = EVENT_TYPE in Battles, Explosions/Remote violence, Violence against civilians, which omits "Excessive force against protesters" and "Mob violence".

Admin1 kept in the period (19): Abyei, Al Jazirah, Blue Nile, Central Darfur, East Darfur, Gedaref, Kassala, Khartoum, North Darfur, North Kordofan, Northern, Red Sea, River Nile, Sennar, South Darfur, South Kordofan, West Darfur, West Kordofan, White Nile.
